question:
Which two digits and signs need to be interchanged so as to balance the given equation?

75 − 13 + 19 × 8 ÷ 5 = 93
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03f606139c736cc1af8c6f5c78ea44c324f88530185109c0f836e68c8ced7a54.png] 

Given: 75 − 13 + 19 × 8 ÷ 5 = 93

By checking options and interchanging accordingly,

(1) 3 and 5; − and ×

LHS = 75 − 13 + 19 × 8 ÷ 5 → 73 × 15 + 19 - 8 ÷ 3 

= 73 × 15 + 19 - 2.67

= 1095 + 19
